build.//: What each profile produces, and what it costs to run. Only the last one needs a paid Apple Developer account.

development.//: Debug build with the dev client attached — hot reload, dev menu, React DevTools. Android gives an installable APK; iOS gives a Simulator build unless credentials exist.

preview.//: Release build, no dev tooling, still sideloadable. This is the one to hand someone to try.

android.//: APK, not the default AAB — an AAB cannot be installed directly, and a release attachment people can actually open is the point.

ios.//: Runs in the iOS Simulator and needs no Apple account. Remove `simulator` to get a device-installable IPA, which does need one.

preview-ios-device.//: An actual .ipa for a real iPhone. Requires a paid Apple Developer account ($99/yr) with credentials in EAS — Apple requires code signing for device installs and there is no way around it.

production.//: Store submission: an AAB for Play and a signed IPA for App Store Connect.
